footer.description: Interactive step-by-step guide for setting up OpenClaw with AI-powered assistance.

landing.heroDescription: Interactive step-by-step guide with AI assistance on every step. From zero to a fully running OpenClaw agent on Google Cloud or your local machine.
landing.benefitsTitle: What You Get After Completing the Guide
landing.benefitsDescription: Every item below is a verified, working result you will have at the end.
landing.benefit0: Fully configured VM on Google Cloud for OpenClaw (Ubuntu 24.04)
landing.benefit1: Stable SSH access with host key management explained
landing.benefit2: Proper Service Account + IAM roles + Access scopes (no more 403 errors)
landing.benefit3: Vertex AI authorization via ADC without JSON service-account keys
landing.benefit4: Node.js 22+ and OpenClaw installed via npm without root issues
landing.benefit5: OpenClaw gateway as a systemd user service with auto-start after reboot
landing.benefit6: Telegram bot connected via onboard + pairing for remote control
landing.benefit7: Dashboard access via SSH tunnel (no open ports to the internet)
landing.benefit8: Autonomy controls: sudo whitelist for bot install/deploy operations
landing.benefit9: VM backup and restore (snapshots / machine images) for safe experimentation
landing.stepsSubtitle: Each step has interactive checklists, copy-paste commands, and an AI assistant ready to help.
landing.step0desc: Billing, APIs, Service Account, IAM roles
landing.step2desc: Key generation, connection, host key management
landing.step3desc: Ubuntu packages, gcloud, ADC, Node.js, OpenClaw
landing.aiDescription: Paste an error message or upload a screenshot — the AI analyzes your specific issue in context and gives you exact commands to fix it.
landing.testimonial0quote: I spent 3 days trying to set up OpenClaw from docs alone. With this guide, everything worked in 4 hours. The AI assistant saved me at least twice when I hit permission errors.
landing.testimonial1quote: The step-by-step format with copy-paste commands is exactly what I needed. No guessing, no ambiguity. The screenshot analysis feature is magic.
landing.testimonial2quote: Even as someone experienced with GCP, I found value in the guide. The security best practices and systemd service configuration were spot-on.
landing.testimonial3quote: Worth every penny. I had zero Linux experience and now I have a fully running AI agent on Google Cloud. The progress tracking kept me motivated.
landing.faq0a: OpenClaw is an AI agent that can be deployed locally or on a remote server. It integrates with various services (Telegram, Vertex AI, OpenAI) and can be managed through a web dashboard or Telegram bot.
landing.faq1q: Do I need prior experience with Google Cloud or Linux?
landing.faq1a: No! This guide is designed for complete beginners. Every step is explained in detail, with copy-paste commands and troubleshooting for common errors.
landing.faq2q: What does the AI assistant do?
landing.faq2a: On each step, you can paste error text or upload a screenshot. The AI analyzes your specific issue in the context of that step and gives you exact commands or configuration changes to fix it.
landing.faq3q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
landing.faq3a: Yes, you can cancel in one click from your profile. You'll keep access until the end of your paid period.
landing.faq4q: What if I break my VM?
landing.faq4a: The guide teaches you to create snapshots before risky changes. You can restore your VM to a working state in 5-10 minutes.
landing.faq5q: Is there a local setup option?
landing.faq5a: Yes, the guide covers both remote (Google Cloud VM) and local installation scenarios.
landing.ctaDescription: Join the guide, follow the steps, and have your AI agent running in a few hours — not days.
